executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $164.32 per resident day (45.5% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 0.6% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $36,526, 0.6% of the $5,838,557 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,223,389, $34.43 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $695,429 (56.8%), allocated fringe $118,691 (9.7%), non-wage costs $409,269 (33.5%). Raw food was $369,261 ($10.39 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $286,625, $8.07 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $184,721 (64.4%), allocated fringe $31,527 (11.0%), non-wage costs $70,377 (24.6%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $348,961, $9.82 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $203,939 (58.4%), allocated fringe $34,807 (10.0%), non-wage costs $110,215 (31.6%).
Missing data: cost year 2023 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075411/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2023 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; costs per resident day outside the plausible range). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
